content.title: ‘Daredevil: Born Again’ Season 2 Episode 1 – release date, schedule, how to watch
content.text: Following the success of Season 1, "Daredevil: Born Again" will return to Disney+ this week, starting March 24 when Episode 1 premieres on the streaming service at 6 p.m. PT/9 p.m. ET.Charlie Cox returns as Matt Murdock/Daredevil, alongside Vincent D'Onofrio as Wilson Fisk, with Deborah Ann Woll as Karen Page, Margarita Levieva as Heather Glenn, Wilson Bethel as Benjamin 'Dex' Poindexter, and Jon Bernthal as Frank Castle aka The Punisher, and Matthew Lillard as Mr. Charles. Season 1 ended with Fisk becoming Mayor Kingpin, while Daredevil was unleashed as chaos took over the city. Now, Season 2 will continue the story, as new episodes drop each Tuesday on Disney+.Matt Murdock/Daredevil (Charlie Cox) on the set of Marvel Television's DAREDEVIL: BORN AGAIN, exclusively on Disney+. Photo by Jojo Whilden. © 2025 MA... | Photo by Jojo Whilden'Daredevil: Born Again' Season 2 Episode 1 Release Date"Daredevil: Born Again" Season 2 Episode 1 will be available to stream on Disney+ on March 24, 2026.New episodes of "Daredevil: Born Again" premiere on Disney+ each Tuesday through May 12, 2026.'Daredevil: Born Again' Season 2 Episode 1 – How to Watch"Daredevil: Born Again" Season 2 Episode 1 will be available on Disney+ from 6 p.m. PT/9 p.m. ET on March 24, 2026.A Disney+ subscription is required to watch "Daredevil: Born Again." A basic subscription with ads costs $11.99 per month, or you can get Disney+ Premium without ads for $18.99 per month or $189.99 per year.What Time Does 'Daredevil: Born Again' Season 2 Episode 1 Come Out?"Daredevil: Born Again" Season 2 Episode 1 will land on Disney+ at 6 p.m. PT/9 p.m. ET on March 24, 2026.With the evening streaming release in the United States, it will debut in other countries at different times. Here is when "Daredevil: Born Again" will be available to stream in different time zones:March 24BRT: 10:00 pmMarch 25BST: 2:00 amCEST: 3:00 amIST: 6:30 amJST: 10:00 amAET: 12:00 pmNZDT: 2:00 pmWill All Episodes of 'Daredevil: Born Again' Land at Once?No. New episodes will release weekly through May 12.'Daredevil: Born Again' Season 2 Release ScheduleEpisode 1: March 24Episode 2: March 31Episode 3: April 7Episode 4: April 14Episode 5: April 21Episode 6: April 28Episode 7: May 5Episode 8: May 12'Daredevil: Born Again' Season 2 Episode 1 RuntimeThere are no confirmed runtimes for episodes of Season 2 yet. Episodes in Season 1 ran between 39 and 61 minutes.What Will Happen in 'Daredevil: Born Again' Season 2 Episode 1?Episode synopses for Season 2 of "Daredevil: Born Again" are yet to be announced.
